Overview

Scranton is a city in PA with a population of 76,000. Electric City with The Office fame, the Steamtown National Historic Site, and coal history. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
